macro.reasoning: The engine at cycle-93 shows no sustained, multi-sensor degradation trend. Deviations are transient and isolated: sensor 7 spiked to -5.18σ at cycle-92 but returned to normal; sensor 14 oscillates between ±2.4–2.9σ without persistence; sensor 3 shows occasional +2.6 to +4.1σ excursions (cycles 52, 54, 73, 85) but reverts; sensor 9 fluctuates ±2–2.6σ; sensor 20 hovers near ±2–3σ with no consistent direction. No sensor pair degrades together over consecutive cycles. The latest window (cycles 88–93) contains only two mild flags (sensor 9 +2.3σ, sensor 12 -2.14σ). With 50 cycles of noisy but bounded operation and no coherent degradation signature, the engine remains in early-life/healthy regime. RUL is estimated well below the 125 cap but far from imminent failure.

micro.reasoning: Engine at cycle-93 shows no persistent multi-sensor degradation trend. Recent deviations (sensor 7: -5.18σ, sensor 14: ±2.4-2.8σ, sensor 9: ±2.1-2.3σ) are isolated, alternating in direction, and lack sustained co-movement. Core sensors (2, 3, 4, 8, 11, 12, 13, 15, 17, 20, 21) remain within ±3σ with small cycle-to-cycle changes. No evidence of accelerating wear; RUL remains high, consistent with early-life operation.
step_reasoning: At cycle-93 (final observed), sensor 9 is +2.30σ (change +4.22) and sensor 12 is -2.14σ (change -0.18), but these are single-cycle excursions without persistence. Sensor 7 showed -5.18σ at cycle-92 but recovered; sensor 14 oscillates (±2.4-2.8σ) without trend. Sensor 3 spiked +4.11σ at cycle-85 but normalized. No sensor shows sustained deviation >3σ over consecutive cycles. All core gas-path temperatures (sensors 3,4,7,8,11,12,13) and pressures (2,14,15,17,20,21) remain stable. synthesis.reasoning: Both macro (105.0) and micro (102.3) outlooks agree the engine shows no sustained, multi-sensor degradation through cycle-93. Deviations are transient and alternating: sensor 7 spiked to -5.18σ at cycle-92 but recovered; sensor 14 oscillates ±2.4–2.9σ without persistence; sensor 3 has occasional +2.6 to +4.1σ excursions (cycles 52, 54, 73, 85) that revert; sensor 9 fluctuates ±2.1–2.6σ; sensor 20 hovers near ±2–3σ with no consistent direction. The latest window (cycles 88–93) contains only two mild flags (sensor 9 +2.30σ, sensor 12 -2.14σ). Core gas-path temperatures (3, 4, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13) and pressures (2, 14, 15, 17, 20, 21) remain stable with small cycle-to-cycle changes. No sensor pair degrades together over consecutive cycles. Weighting macro and micro equally (both rely on the same quantitative evidence and reach consistent conclusions), the final estimate is the midpoint 103.7 cycles. Uncertainty stems from the short observation window (50 cycles) and noisy, non-persistent deviations, but the evidence does not support a near-term failure or the 125-cycle cap.
